dataTags.description: The list of {@link DataTag}s to run tagging logic for.

baseDataTags.description: The list of {@link DataTagBase} instances to run tagging logic for.

entityIds.description: The list of entities to tag.

isBatchingExpressions.description:
Whether or not the batch is batching all {@link DataTag}s/{@link DataTagBase} instances with the
same srcType at once.

title:
A single batch of entities to tag or single batch of {@link DataTag}s to run tagging logic for.
If {@link PopulateDataTagsBatch#entityIds} is specified then only one {@link DataTag} should be specified unless
{@link PopulateDataTagsBatch#isBatchingExpressions} is set to true in which case a single scan of the table for
a type is bering performed for all expressions.
name: PopulateDataTagsBatch
